== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English Decipher-era [[Commander Nemet]] articles: one column per published text state in date order (Original, Decipher's errata, then each Players Committee image). Yellow highlights mark what changed against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments. Revised, Japanese, foil and Virtual printings remain in Versions.
